title: Party Lemonade
statementMd:
A New Year party is not a New Year party without lemonade! As usual, you are expecting a lot of guests, and buying lemonade has already become a pleasant necessity.

Your favorite store sells lemonade in bottles of $*n*$ different volumes at different costs. A single bottle of type $*i*$ has volume $2^{*i* - 1}$ liters and costs $*c*_{*i*}$ roubles. The number of bottles of each type in the store can be considered infinite.

You want to buy at least $*L*$ liters of lemonade. How many roubles do you have to spend?

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$ and $*L*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 30$; $1 ≤ *L* ≤ 10^{9}$) — the number of types of bottles in the store and the required amount of lemonade in liters, respectively.

The second line contains $*n*$ integers $*c*_{1}, *c*_{2}, ..., *c*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) — the costs of bottles of different types.

## Output

Output a single integer — the smallest number of roubles you have to pay in order to buy at least $*L*$ liters of lemonade.

## Note

In the first example you should buy one 8-liter bottle for 90 roubles and two 2-liter bottles for 30 roubles each. In total you'll get 12 liters of lemonade for just 150 roubles.

In the second example, even though you need only 3 liters, it's cheaper to buy a single 8-liter bottle for 10 roubles.

In the third example it's best to buy three 1-liter bottles for 10 roubles each, getting three liters for 30 roubles.
statementZhMd:
新年派对如果没有柠檬水，就不能算是真正的新年派对！和往常一样，你预计会有很多客人，而购买柠檬水已经成为一件令人愉快且必不可少的事情。

你最喜欢的商店出售 $*n*$ 种不同容量、不同价格的柠檬水瓶。第 $*i*$ 种瓶子的容量为 $2^{*i* - 1}$ 升，价格为 $*c*_{*i*}$ 卢布。商店中每种瓶子的数量都可以认为是无限的。

你想购买至少 $*L*$ 升柠檬水。你至少需要花费多少卢布？

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*L*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 30$；$1 ≤ *L* ≤ 10^{9}$）——商店中瓶子的种类数，以及所需的柠檬水升数。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*c*_{1}, *c*_{2}, ..., *c*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$）——不同种类瓶子的价格。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——为了购买至少 $*L*$ 升柠檬水，所需支付的最少卢布数。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，你应该购买一瓶 8 升装柠檬水，价格为 90 卢布，再购买两瓶 2 升装柠檬水，每瓶价格为 30 卢布。总共可以得到 12 升柠檬水，只需花费 150 卢布。

在第二个样例中，尽管你只需要 3 升柠檬水，但购买一瓶 8 升装柠檬水只需 10 卢布，因此这样更便宜。

在第三个样例中，最好的选择是购买三瓶 1 升装柠檬水，每瓶价格为 10 卢布，共得到 3 升柠檬水，花费 30 卢布。
